items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: so then I got another teacher, a gentleman, his name was Fraley, and I remember him because he was a short, fat guy

ctx.x: we didn't miss anything -- what was your first teacher's name, or who first started you on piano?

I had a lady, I never knew her name, but she would sit there and eat candy, and I know I'd be making mistakes, so I told my mother, I told her -- "Look, she's eating candy all the time, and I make a whole lot of mistakes and she'll be saying that's very good" -- so then I got another teacher, a gentleman, his name was Fraley, and I remember him because he was a short, fat guy and he had a church choir up there in Malden, and he said he'd give me lessons if you'll come and sing, and he said he'd give me a tryout…
I'd go up there and he'd give me lessons, and he was very strict.
